document.channel: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs

notes: Confidence is low, and the reason matters. The qualitative rules above were read directly from the Consulate General in Warsaw's photo page: a light white or off-white background, not more than 6 months old, full face, non-smiling, and no sunglasses or head covering except for religious or ethnic reasons. That page states NO dimensions.

The 35 x 45 mm size and the 70-80% face proportion are attributed to the Consulate General in New York, whose page could not be loaded to confirm them - it returned an empty document. They are consistent with the ICAO standard Russia follows and with every other 35 x 45 document here, but they were not read first-hand. Check them against your own consulate before relying on this spec.
Russian consulates differ from one another, and the consulate handling your application is the authority. Treat this spec as a starting point rather than a rule.
No digital pixel size is stated, so the sizes here are 300 to 600 dpi at 35 x 45 mm, keeping the 7:9 aspect exactly.
notEnforced: Photo not more than 6 months old.
Printed on normal photographic paper (camera print).
No sunglasses, hat or cap, unless worn for religious or ethnic reasons - the app cannot detect these.
Non-smiling: the app checks that the mouth is closed but cannot judge a smile.
The photograph must be stuck onto the visa application form.
The dimensions themselves are not first-hand verified - see "Where this comes from", below.

headHeight.note: Stated as a proportion - the face must take up 70-80% of the photo - which on a 45 mm photo is 31.5-36.0 mm. NOT first-hand verified; see status.notes.

background.editingRisk: We replaced the background with an off-white. The consulate requires a light white or off-white background; a photo taken against such a wall is safer.

sources.title: Consulate General of the Russian Federation in Warsaw: Photo specification
sources.says: one recent colour photo (not more than 6 months old); taken against a light background (white or off-white) so that features are distinguishable and contrast against the background; clear quality and with the face in focus; printed on normal photographic paper (camera print); full face, non-smiling, without sunglasses, a hat/cap or other head covering unless worn because of religious belief or ethnic background. States no dimensions.

sources.title: Consulate General of the Russian Federation in New York: Russian visa photo specifications
sources.says: Reported to state 35x45 mm with the face taking up 70-80% of the photo, a plain light-coloured background, no more than six months old, full face with neutral expression and mouth closed. NOT VERIFIED FIRST-HAND: the page returned an empty document when fetched.
